goal: 完成得体的复试自我介绍并给老师留下好印象

n1.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
n1.line: Good morning. Please begin by giving a brief self-introduction, covering your academic background and research interests.
n1.lineCn: 早上好。请先做一个简要的自我介绍,涵盖你的学业背景和研究兴趣。

grammar.name: 祈使句 + 非谓语结构
grammar.note: begin by giving... 中 by 后接动名词 giving 作方式状语,这是复试口语中常见的礼貌指令句式,比直接命令式更得体。

options.text: Good morning, Professor Wang. I am Li Ming, a senior student majoring in Applied Linguistics at Beijing Normal University. My research interest lies in second language acquisition.
options.textCn: 早上好,王教授。我叫李明,是北京师范大学应用语言学专业的大四学生。我的研究兴趣在于二语习得。
options.feedback: 结构清晰:问候 + 姓名 + 专业背景 + 研究兴趣,直接回答了老师的全部要求。

options.text: Hello. My name is Li Ming. I come from a small city in China. My father is a teacher and my mother works in a hospital.
options.textCn: 你好。我叫李明。我来自中国一个小城市。我爸爸是老师,妈妈在医院工作。
options.feedback: 虽然礼貌,但讲家庭琐事偏离了复试要点,复试自我介绍应聚焦学业与研究。
过于简短,既没有介绍专业背景,也没有提及研究兴趣,浪费了展示自己的机会。

n2.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
n2.line: Impressive. Could you tell me more specifically what attracted you to the field of second language acquisition, which is a rather competitive direction this year?
n2.lineCn: 不错。你能更具体地说说是什么吸引你选择二语习得这个方向吗?今年这个方向竞争相当激烈。

grammar.name: 宾语从句嵌套 + 非限定性定语从句
grammar.note: what attracted you 是宾语从句,后面 which is a rather competitive direction 是非限定性定语从句修饰 field,典型的多层从句嵌套长难句。

options.text: What fascinates me most is how learners acquire implicit knowledge through meaningful interaction, and I have been reading Krashen's input hypothesis, which deeply shaped my perspective.
options.textCn: 最吸引我的是学习者如何通过有意义的互动获得内隐知识,我一直在读克拉申的输入假说,这深刻影响了我。
options.feedback: 结合具体理论展示学术素养,用 which 引导的非限定性定语从句补充说明,展现了扎实的文献基础。

options.text: I think English is very interesting, and my English scores have always been high since primary school.
options.textCn: 我觉得英语很有趣,从小英语成绩一直很高。
options.feedback: 内容过于笼统且只谈成绩,复试老师更希望听到具体的研究兴趣和学术思考。

options.text: To be honest, I chose this direction because it is easier to get in.
options.textCn: 说实话,我选这个方向是因为好考。
options.feedback: 动机不当,直接暴露了功利心态,会给老师留下非常差的印象。

n3.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
n3.line: I see. Perhaps you could also share what relevant research experience you have gained, if any, during your undergraduate years.
n3.lineCn: 我明白了。也许你还可以分享一下本科期间如果有什么相关的科研经历。

grammar.name: 插入语 + 条件从句
grammar.note: if any 是插入语,相当于 if there is any relevant experience,使句子简洁;what 引导宾语从句。这是典型的书面化长句结构。

options.text: I participated in a research project on vocabulary acquisition strategies, where I was responsible for data collection and statistical analysis using SPSS.
options.textCn: 我参与过一个关于词汇习得策略的研究项目,负责用 SPSS 进行数据收集和统计分析。
options.feedback: 用 where 引导的定语从句描述经历,具体且有细节,展现出真实的科研训练。

options.text: I have no research experience, but I promise I will work very hard if I am admitted.
options.textCn: 我没有科研经历,但我保证如果被录取会非常努力。
options.feedback: 诚实但缺乏竞争力,可以谈谈课程论文或毕业设计来弥补。

options.text: I have too many experiences to mention one by one.
options.textCn: 我经历太多,没法一一列举。
options.feedback: 敷衍且自大,老师追问反而会让你陷入被动。

n4.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
n4.line: Very good. One last question: what do you consider to be your greatest strength when it comes to academic research, and what weakness are you currently working on?
n4.lineCn: 很好。最后一个问题:就学术研究而言,你认为自己最大的优势是什么?现在又在改进什么弱点?

grammar.name: what 引导的表语从句 + when it comes to
grammar.note: what you consider... 作表语,when it comes to 是固定短语"当谈到……时",后接名词或动名词,属于长难句中常见的套语结构。

options.text: My greatest strength is perseverance, as evidenced by my year-long preparation for this examination; meanwhile, I am working to improve my public speaking, which I believe will matter in future academic seminars.
options.textCn: 我最大的优势是毅力,一年备考可以证明;同时我在改进公开演讲能力,我相信这在未来的学术研讨会上很重要。
options.feedback: 优缺点都具体可感,用 as evidenced by 和 which 从句丰富了表达,回答了老师的问题且不显傲慢。

options.text: I am perfect in every way, and I have no weaknesses at all.
options.textCn: 我各方面都很完美,完全没有弱点。
options.feedback: 缺乏自我认知,这种回答会被认为不成熟,老师很难再继续提问。

options.text: I think my weakness is that I like English too much, which makes me spend all my time on it.
options.textCn: 我的缺点是我太喜欢英语了,把所有时间都花在上面。
options.feedback: 把优点伪装成缺点的回答过于套路,老师面试过很多考生,这样的答案缺乏真诚。

success.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
success.line: Thank you, Li Ming. Your introduction was well structured and your answers demonstrated genuine academic curiosity. We will contact you soon.
success.lineCn: 谢谢你,李明。你的介绍结构清晰,回答也展现了真诚的学术好奇心。我们会尽快联系你。

fail1.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
fail1.line: I see. That will be all for your introduction. Please wait outside for the further arrangements.
fail1.lineCn: 我明白了。你的自我介绍部分就到这里,请到外面等待后续安排。

fail2.speaker: 面试老师 Professor Wang
fail2.line: Alright, we have noted your situation. The interview panel will discuss your case collectively afterwards.
fail2.lineCn: 好的,你的情况我们记下了。面试组之后会集体讨论。
